name: std::unique_lock<Mutex>::unlock
intro:
Unlocks (i.e., releases ownership of) the associated mutex.

std::system_error is thrown if there is no associated mutex or if the mutex is not locked.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: If there is no associated mutex or the mutex is not locked, std::system_error with an error code of std::errc::operation_not_permitted.

summary: Unlocks (i.e., releases ownership of) the associated mutex.
